newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Money Store Q2 net income rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Money Store Q2 net income rises.

text.p: Gain, sale of receivables, including net
(Dollars in thousands except per share data)
NOTE: Compared with the previous quarter, delinquency rates dropped 10 basis points to 6.49% and charge-offs were flat at an annualized rate of 57 basis points.
In auto division, delinquencies increased 82 basis points to 4.25% and charge-offs were 3.82% on an annualized basis.
Q2 1997 loan originations were $1.7 billion, a 28% increase over originations of $1.3 billion for Q2 1996.

For the quarter ended June 30, 1997, home equity loan net charge-offs were $13.5 million, which annualizes to 57 basis points of home equity loans serviced, compared with 48 basis points annualized for the second quarter of 1996.

Commercial loan net charge-offs were $965,000 for the second quarter of 1997, or 54 basis points annualized of unguaranteed commercial loans serviced, compared with 44 basis points annualized for the same period in 1996.

Auto loan net charge-offs for the second quarter of 1997 were $6.8 million, or 382 basis points annualized of auto loans serviced, compared with 152 basis points annualized for the second quarter of 1996.
